debit.notes: Call the toll-free Call Center 18004256708 from your registered mobile number to block a lost/stolen/damaged debit card, or visit your home branch; per the bank's Customer Advisory FAQ (eAPGB & eAPGVB to APGB migration, v3.0 dated 10-10-2025) this is the documented blocking procedure, and the toll-free numbers printed on erstwhile eAPGB/eAPGVB debit cards no longer work post-migration. The Call Center is available 24/7. Internet banking at https://netbanking.apgb.bank.in/ (linked as 'Click Here' from the bank's NetBanking page) has a 'Debit Card Services' page, and the mobile banking app 'APGB Money' has a 'Debit Card Services' menu, both documented in the same advisory for card services; no SMS block keyword is published on the bank's pages. The bank's cyber-security page asks customers to report cyber crime by dialling 1930 or visiting www.cybercrime.gov.in / https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/. No overseas helpline is published on these pages.

credit.notes: No credit-card programme or credit-card-specific blocking channel appears anywhere on the bank's official pages fetched live on 2026-10-31 (homepage, NetBanking page, cyber-security page and the Customer Advisory FAQ); only RuPay debit (ATM) card procedures are documented, so credit-card blocking is not offered/not documented by this bank. Customers would use the same 24/7 Call Center 18004256708 or home-branch channels.

upi.notes: No UPI block/freeze channel of any kind is published on the bank's official pages fetched live on 2026-11-01: no in-app UPI lock or deregister path in 'APGB Money' (the Mobile Banking Terms & Conditions PDF never mentions UPI), no netbanking UPI manage/disable option, no SMS keyword and no USSD freeze code; the bank's own https://apgb.bank.in/upi page covers Merchant UPI QR only. UPI is documented as an Issuer service through third-party apps: 'Customers to download any UPI App from Google play store and to register for UPI service by selecting our Bank name, Account No., create UPI VPA ID, to enter Rupay debit (ATM) card details' (Technology Products page) and 'You can perform registration for UPI through any UPI apps - BHIM,Phonepe, Bharat pe, etc.' (Customer Advisory FAQ); *99# is published only for registration ('Customers are to dial *99# from their mobile, to type 'CHAI' for choosing our bank'), not for blocking. Emergency route: the 24/7 Call Center 18004256708 (popup 'Toll-Free Number: 1800 425 6708 (Available 24/7)'), and the bank's Financial Complaint form at https://apgb.bank.in/complaints-grievances which lists 'UPI' among its Transaction Type options (AEPS, ATM, BBPS, IMPS, NACH, NEFT, POS & ECOM, RTGS, UPI, Others) with date, amount, account number and transaction reference number; the advisory adds 'In case of issues, you may approach bank branch or raise e-complaints for resolution.' For cyber fraud the bank's cyber-security page says 'To report any Cyber Crime Dial 1930 or visit www.cybercrime.gov.in / https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/'.
